subject: Cypress Financial — request for prioritized feature slot and runtime isolation
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Cypress Financial — prioritized feature ask (routing + residency)

Priya / Monica —

Following up from the call with Alex and their infra team this morning. Cypress Financial is asking for a short list of features we can commit to in Q2 to meet their procurement gating:

- Tenant routing pinning (deterministic routing to a dedicated pool)
- Residency guarantee (region-bound execution + audit log export)
- Small warm-pool for low-latency critical flows (50 concur.)

They explicitly said they won't sign the reserved capacity contract without a written commitment on at least the first two items and a high-level timeline. Procurement wants a mutual action plan by next Wednesday.

I've attached the draft spec they shared (cypress_mvp_spec.pdf) and the initial cost ask (cypress_cost_model_v2.xlsx).

Can product/eng advise on scope and whether we can offer a limited-scope commitment (routing + residency) that avoids a full KV cache implementation in sprint 1? If we can commit to staged delivery (routing+residency first, warm-pool later) that will likely unblock their PO.

Next step: can we produce a one-page MAP + tentative sprint window by EOD Monday?

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter | Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: cypress_mvp_spec.pdf, cypress_cost_model_v2.xlsx
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Mar 2028 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cypress Financial — prioritized feature ask (routing + residency)

On Fri, Mar 3, 2028 at 9:12 AM Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com> wrote:
> Priya / Monica —
> 
> Following up from the call with Alex and their infra team this morning...

Thanks for the context and the artifacts, Ben. Short answers up front:

- Routing pinning: engineering feasible as a routing+policy layer that maps requests to a dedicated pool (work estimate: 3-4 dev-weeks + 1 week infra/testing).
- Residency guarantee: we can provide region-bound placement and enable a scoped audit export (S3 log export) in ~2 dev-weeks if we limit the initial scope to route-level metadata and export hooks.
- Warm-pool: needs more ops work (autoscaling + seeding) — estimate 4-6 dev-weeks and requires capacity reservation.

Tradeoffs to call out:
- If we skip full KV cache warmup and focus on routing and placement, we can hit Cypress's timeline but their 99th pct latency for cold flows will be higher initially.
- Audit/export scope: we should confirm retention and PII redaction expectations from their security team before committing to an export SLA.

Action items I need from Cypress (can you push for these on the MAP):
1) Clear list of telemetry fields they require in audit exports.
2) PO / contract target date and whether they can accept staged acceptance criteria.

If that's acceptable I can draft a 1-page MAP with engineering window (tentative: start sprint 2 — feature work in weeks 2–5, canary in week 6) by Monday EOD.

Monica
Monica Patel | Product Lead, Platform Features
monica.patel@redwood.com | Redwood Inference
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@cypressfinancial.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Cypress Financial Procurement <procurement@cypressfinancial.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Mar 2028 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cypress Financial — prioritized feature ask (routing + residency)

Ben / Priya / Monica —

Thanks — quick clarifications from our side:

- Audit fields: we need tenant id, request id, model id, region, timestamp, and a redaction flag. Retention target: 1 year.
- PO timeline: procurement wants the mutual action plan + estimated delivery window by next Wednesday; they will start a parallel review and legal will only sign after we confirm region residency and the audit export capability.
- Acceptance: we can accept a staged rollout (routing+residency first) as long as the MAP includes explicit acceptance criteria for the first stage and a go/no-go decision gate.

I uploaded a one-page list of our minimal acceptance criteria — see attached 'cypress_mvp_spec.pdf' (same doc). We can also start a DocuSign for a MAP if you prefer: https://www.docusign.com/CF-MAP-2047

Alex Chen
Head of Platform Engineering, Cypress Financial
alex.chen@cypressfinancial.com | +1 212-555-0145

Attachment: cypress_mvp_spec.pdf
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 05 Mar 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cypress Financial — prioritized feature ask (routing + residency)

Team —

Thanks for the quick turn. Based on Monica's estimates and Alex's acceptance constraints, I'm authorizing a limited-scope commitment to unblock the deal:

Decision: Greenlight routing pinning + region residency export as a prioritized workstream.
Scope (stage 1):
- Routing/policy layer to map tenant requests to a dedicated pool (prod flagging + config UI)
- Region-bound placement + S3 audit export with fields: tenant_id, request_id, model_id, region, timestamp, redaction_flag
- Documentation: acceptance checklist for Cypress and verification steps for security

Constraints / tradeoffs:
- No KV cache warmup in stage 1; warm-pool to be scoped separately and delivered after signed PO (stage 2).
- We will define performance acceptance as: 95th pct latency within X ms (to be finalized) for routed flows; higher cold latency acceptable initially.

Owners & ETA:
- Monica: product spec and MAP draft (owner) — deliver Monday EOD (03/06)
- Jordan / Karthik: engineering schedule and sprint nomination — initial plan by Tuesday EOD (03/07)
- Ben: lock PO target date with procurement and send final acceptance list from Alex (owner)

Ben / Monica: please assemble the one-page MAP (mutual_action_plan_draft.docx) and a hubspot update for CF-2047. Once we have their procurement target, we'll commit sprint capacity and announce to Eng triage.

Priya
Priya Natarajan | Head of Sales Strategy, Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0233
